attempts.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 over their shared transit link (10.10.0.0/30), routing node3's lan-a (10.10.1.0/24) and node4's lan-b (10.10.2.0/24) across it. Verified private-address reachability (node3<->node4) and confirmed encryption in transit via simultaneous packet capture on the plaintext LAN side vs. opaque WireGuard UDP on the transit side. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all four nodes one at a time, proving boot-id changes and post-restart recovery of interfaces, tunnel handshake, routes, and end-to-end connectivity.
